title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Collection-History Rates on Reduced Withholding
content:
The collection history of a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** sets a history rate on the approved monthly reduced withholding.

**Rule.** When a waiver was denied on the debt in the last six calendar months and the benefit offsets posted on the debt add up to at least the collected-share percentage of 40 percent of the original amount, the heavy-collection rate of 95 percent applies. When a waiver was denied in that period and the offsets add up to less, the light-collection rate of 98 percent applies. Otherwise no history rate applies.

**Reading the records.** A denied waiver is a waiver decision on the debt with the outcome denied, dated in the period by its decision date (fewer than six whole calendar months before today). The offsets are every benefit offset ever posted on the debt, added together; direct payments are not offsets. The original amount is the principal established on the debt record. The history rate is a percentage by which the approved figure is multiplied before the withholding is rounded up to the cent.

| Waiver denied in the last six months | Offsets against 40 percent of the original amount | History rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | At least | 95 percent |
| Yes | Less | 98 percent |
| No | Either | None |

**Hypothetical case.** Original amount 5,000.00 USD (40 percent is 2,000.00 USD), offsets totalling 2,000.00 USD, a waiver denied two months ago: 95 percent. Offsets of 1,999.99 USD: 98 percent.
